_comment: Expiry date (UTC, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) and tracking issue for each OpenVEX not_affected waiver under .github/vex/. scripts/scout-cve-gate.sh ignores a waiver past its date, with no entry, or more than 120 days out, and warns 14 days before; scripts/vex-live.sh drops it from the attested doc; scripts/vex-ttl-check.sh keeps this file and the statements in step. Default TTL 90 days. Renew by re-checking the drop trigger, then moving the date. Delete the entry with its statement.
